definitions.explanation: Discussions related to business deals or transactions.

examples.japanese: {商談|しょうだん}がまとまった。
{商談|しょうだん}に{臨|のぞ}む。
{商談|しょうだん}が{成立|せいりつ}した。

notes:
{商談|しょうだん} refers to business negotiations or discussions, especially in B2B contexts.

WORD FORMATION:
{商|しょう} (commerce) + {談|だん} (talk/discussion)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {商談|しょうだん}がまとまる: deal comes together
- {商談|しょうだん}が{成立|せいりつ}する: deal is concluded
- {商談|しょうだん}に{臨|のぞ}む: to engage in negotiations
- {商談|しょうだん}を{進|すす}める: to advance negotiations

RELATED WORDS:
- {交渉|こうしょう}: negotiation (general)
- {取引|とりひき}: transaction, deal
- {契約|けいやく}: contract

{商談|しょうだん} specifically implies business-related negotiations, while {交渉|こうしょう} is broader and can apply to any type of negotiation.
